canada.title: Man arrested over alleged racist threat to run over people in Toronto
canada.summary: A 55-year-old man is facing charges after allegedly threatening to drive into people in Toronto 'because of their perceived race,' Hamilton police say.

canada.title: Jill Dunlop, Ontario's colleges and universities minister until 2024, refuses to answer OSAP questions
canada.summary: Ontario's former minister of colleges and universities, who presided over the file for three years until 2024, is refusing to answer questions about a growing OSAP scandal.

canada.title: Feds open consultation period on proposed changes that may put migratory birds at risk
canada.summary: Ottawa is asking for public feedback on amendments some say will relax laws meant to protect migratory birds.

canada.title: Granby Zoo offers to rehome bat colony living in Quebec long-term care facility
canada.summary: Officials are still figuring out what do with the bats in a long-term care home in Sorel-Tracy, Que., where a rabies-infected bat came into contact with a resident earlier this month. One of the options being considered is transporting the colony to Granby Zoo's bat refuge.

canada.title: Alberta bill would ban some bike lanes, let transportation minister remove others
canada.summary: Alberta’s government is proposing to ban future bike lanes that remove or restrict motor-vehicle traffic and give itself the power to remove some existing bike lanes.

canada.title: Alouettes QB suffered fractured rib, joint in loss
canada.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander says he played through a fractured rib and sternoclavicular joint in the second half of Sunday's Grey Cup loss.

canada.title: Weight balance, fuel concerns highlighted in report on deadly 2025 Manitoba plane crash
canada.summary: An investigation into an airplane crash that killed four in northern Manitoba last year has raised concerns about weight balance and fuel storage on a flight that almost didn't happen.

canada.title: Blue Bombers fire head coach Mike O'Shea after 12 seasons
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers announced Thursday they have parted ways with longtime head coach Mike O’Shea.

canada.title: Crime rate falling across the Yukon, says latest report
canada.summary: Crime rate down more than 10 per cent but RCMP commander says public perceptions may differ

canada.title: Braving staffing hurdles, N.W.T. RCMP head to Aurora College to try and turn the page
canada.summary: Facing numerous staffing hurdles, Northwest Territories RCMP will be at Aurora College next week to try and turn the page. It’s part of the federal government's plan to boost RCMP personnel by more than 1,000.

canada.title: Case of Saint John man accused of killing wife with his car now in hands of jury
canada.summary: A 12-person jury has begun deliberations following a month-long trial for a man charged with second-degree murder in the death of his wife on Christmas Eve in 2024.

canada.title: N.L. Supreme Court halts nurses' union plan to redo election for president
canada.summary: Three nurses who turned to the Newfoundland and Labrador Supreme Court to halt a planned re-vote for the Registered Nurses' Union of Newfoundland and Labrador’s election and confirm earlier results have been successful.

canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CP24 + Global News (CP), CP24

canada.title: Top court won’t hear bid for class-action lawsuit on behalf of Indigenous children
canada.summary: The Supreme of Court of Canada will not hear a bid to certify a class-action lawsuit against Ottawa on behalf of Indigenous children

canada.title: Norwegian Cruise Line making 17 fewer stops in Halifax next year
canada.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line says in response to guest feedback, it is dropping a Halifax stop from its seven-day round trip starting in Boston, opting to spend an extra day in Bermuda.

canada.title: Anthropic needs rapid growth to keep up spending, as Canadian AI sector heats up
canada.summary: Anthropic's investor documents warn the company needs to increase sales to pay for its data centre leases and infrastructure. At the same time, the company says it needs to plan its data centre investments years in advance, without knowing whether its customers will be there for the long term.

canada.title: Up to $650K offered for 8 fugitives on Canada’s most wanted list
canada.summary: Rewards totaling up to $650,000 are being offered for information leading to the arrests of eight fugitives on Canada's most wanted list.

canada.title: Former top Mountie to be sentenced for assault on teen in B.C. court
canada.summary: A former senior RCMP officer who held a teenager off the floor by their neck while off duty is expected to be sentenced Thursday in a British Columbia provincial court.
